description: Prepares (does not send) an unsigned Solana transaction that swaps a tokenized-treasury token (e.g. USDY) back to USDC via Jupiter. Returns the base64 versioned transaction and a sign link. Nothing is executed: the user reviews and signs it in their own wallet.

amount.description: Amount of the yield token to redeem (token units, e.g. '8.5' USDY) — or 'max' to redeem the entire balance (exact on-chain amount)

name: build_withdraw_yield_tx

error.description: Why the transaction could not be prepared

ok.description: false when the transaction could not be prepared (see error)

signId.description: Id of the prepared, unsigned transaction

signUrl.description: Page where the user reviews and signs in their own wallet (null in local stdio mode)

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 versioned Solana transaction plus lastValidBlockHeight
